Parley and the documentation site are the two Wave 2 apps with no Vercel
deployment to exit. This page records their current hosting route so the
Cloudflare migration inventory is complete.

## Parley

Parley (`apps/parley`) already runs on Cloudflare Workers as a Next.js app
through OpenNext. It has no `vercel.json` and no Vercel workflow.

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Worker | `tuturuuu-parley` (`apps/parley/wrangler.jsonc`) |
| Route | `parley.tuturuuu.com` as a Workers custom domain |
| Build | `bun run --cwd apps/parley build:cloudflare` (`opennextjs-cloudflare build`) |
| Publisher | `parley-cloudflare.yaml`, deploy job on the `production` branch only |
| Bindings | `ASSETS`, `WORKER_SELF_REFERENCE`, `MEETING_AI_PROVIDER` (service `tuturuuu-meet`), `NEXT_INC_CACHE_R2_BUCKET`, `IMAGES`, Durable Object `MEET_LIVE` (script `tuturuuu-meet`) |
| Secrets (names) | `MEET_REALTIME_TOKEN_SECRET`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`, `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY` |

The deploy job verifies the secret names, deploys the CI-built Worker and then
requires `https://parley.tuturuuu.com/access-denied` to answer `200`.

### Smoke

```bash
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://parley.tuturuuu.com/access-denied
curl -sI https://parley.tuturuuu.com/ | head -5
curl -s https://parley.tuturuuu.com/api/build-info
```

Expected: `200`, a redirect to the central sign-in for an anonymous visitor, and the
deployed commit.

### Rollback

Redeploy the previous `parley-worker-<SHA>` artifact with the same deploy job, or
roll the Worker back to its prior Cloudflare version. There is no Vercel route
to return to. Parley's rooms depend on the `tuturuuu-meet` Worker and its
`MeetLiveDurableObject`; never roll the two back independently of a changed
binding contract.

### Native Start port

A port to Start + Void is not required to remove Vercel cost and is not
scheduled. It is a separate change that must preserve `/live-connect` (the
authenticated WebSocket upgrade to `MEET_LIVE`), the service and Durable Object
bindings above, and the room routes.

## Documentation site

`apps/docs` stays on Mintlify (hosted, or `bun dev:docs` locally with the pinned
CLI in `mintlify-version.json`). It has no Next.js, Vercel or Worker build, so
there is nothing to port. Its hostname mapping is provider-side and unchanged by
the Start migration; do not add a Worker route for it.
